# Week 7a

## Learning goals

-   Understand the meaning of percentages and ratio.
-   Know how to perform calculation with percentages and ratio.
-   Know how to calculate percentage changes.

## Percentages and Ratio

### Problem

Transform 3.6 into a percentage.

## Calculating Percentages Changes

$Percentages \; changes = \frac{Change \; between \; values}{original \; value} \times 100 \%$

### Problem

Last month, 250 consumers bought a new smartphone. This month, the number is 420. What is the percentage change in sale?

### Watch

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/QZs8y0Y_3Vk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen>

### Exercises

1.  Last month, 250 consumers bought a new smartphone. This month, the number is down to 100. What is the percentage decrease in sale?

2.  Yesterday there were 250 unique visitors clicking a website. Today, you found that there is a 10% increase in visit. How many clicks are there today?
